coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded recall, not the primary national collector. Production collection remains authoritative and was not modified.
Completed 12 targeted web searches across four miss classes. No tool-reported search failures or verified material access gaps.

No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption reported in the observation interval could be confirmed from fresh local reporting or official agency/provider notices. Search indexing and publication lag limit negative assurance.
